analysis.title: Checkpoint: ROI Calculation Race
analysis.description: A high-tech sci-fi themed interactive checkpoint slide featuring a glowing digital stopwatch timer graphic on the left, a simulated software window containing a word problem on the right, instructional text, and an illuminated answer box at the bottom right.
analysis.layout: The slide is framed by futuristic circuit board borders. The title appears in a glowing tech box at the top left. The left-center contains an oversized digital stopwatch showing '00:00'. The right half contains a window container with a word problem, followed below by an italicized game instruction, and at the bottom right an illuminated callout container showing the answer.

components.visibleText: If a team of 50 analysts at JPMorgan previously spent 4 hours each drafting weekly reports, and AI reduces this to 30 seconds per report, how many total human hours are saved per week?
First pair to calculate the correct answer wins.
